svg.text: Peaceable Queen Armies — Multi-Army Non-Attacking Placements
Place A armies of ≥ k queens on an R×C board so no queen attacks a different army along any row, column, or diagonal
Blue (9) vs Amber (9): exclusive attack corridors never cross.
Blue (5), Emerald (5), Rose (5): same-army clusters pack tightly in corners.
CNF Encoding: q(r,c,a) ⇒ L(ℓ,a) + (¬L(ℓ,a) ∨ ¬L(ℓ,b)) ∀line ℓ, a<b + Sinz counter ∑ q(r,c,a) ≥ k
Same-army queens may freely share rows, columns, and diagonals; every line ℓ belongs to at most one army.
Suite (8 instances · 4 SAT / 4 UNSAT): scales to 15×16 (A=2, k=33), 15×16 (A=3, k=16), and 14×16 (A=4, k=9).
